title: Add degraded-state explainer and evidence path actions
verified: Support Console now renders a degraded_explainer section with cause, impact, source authority, typed next_action and evidence_path.
Degraded items are derived from ProjectionSnapshot, SupportBundleProjection and OperatorProjection only.
Evidence paths are display-safe and secret-like paths are replaced with [REDACTED-PATH].
Next actions are constrained to typed TUI commands and do not introduce shell open or host file manager shortcuts.
Remote audit mirror degradation is represented as optional_dependency=true and does not block baseline operation.
AOM degraded state suggests aom.search or aom.verify only; activation remains gated outside the TUI projection layer.
risk_notes: TUI remains projection-controller only and does not become recovery, resolver or side-effect authority.
Evidence paths are display references, not open-file actions.
Optional remote dependency degradation is surfaced without treating remote mirror as recovery authority.
Normal shell remains unavailable and no host shell/file manager command was added.
